title: Fuyao build-input snapshot metadata (protocol v1)
description: Authoritative schema for private/input.json at the root of a frozen build-input snapshot. The snapshot tree itself (public/ and private/ layout) is specified in the contract README; this file records what was frozen, for which theme, and the digests of the three independently versioned inputs: platform content, site configuration, and theme configuration.

contract.description: Self-identifying protocol constant. Must match the theme manifest inputProtocol.

mode.description: Snapshot purpose: ci builds, local development, private platform preview, or production publication.

theme.description: The theme this snapshot is prepared for. Must equal the id and version of the manifest the platform pairs it with.

themeConfig.description: Theme-specific configuration values validated against the theme's configSchema. Absent means an empty configuration.

contentDigest.description: Digest over the public content tree (posts, data, albums, favicon, fonts, robots.txt).

siteConfigDigest.description: Digest over the normalized site configuration (site-config.json).

themeConfigDigest.description: Digest over the themeConfig object. Equals the digest of the empty object when absent.

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. The pattern checks the shape; format: date-time (enforced by the Go validator via AssertFormat) rejects impossible calendar dates.
